05-23 UC Work-Related Requirements In Work Pilot Scheme
Extension 2023

Contents       Paragraphs


Introduction 1- 2


Changes        3


Annotations


Contents



Introduction
    1. This memo gives guidance on The UC (Work-Related Requirements) In Work Pilot Scheme

         (Extension) Order 20231. This order comes into force on 19.2.23 and extends to England, Wales
         and Scotland.


                           1 UC (Work-Related Requirements) In Work Pilot Scheme (Extension) Order 23,
                                                                                         SI 2023 No. 157


2. The order1 will continue to have effect until the end of the period of twelve months beginning with
19.2.23.


                          1 UC (Work-Related Requirements) In Work Pilot Scheme (Extension) Order 23



Changes
There are no changes to guidance. Decision Makers should follow the existing guidance in Memo ADM
06/18.




Annotations
The number of this Memo 05-23 should be annotated against ADM paragraphs J3192 and J3231 in
addition to Memo 06-18.

Contacts
If you have any queries about this memo, please write to Decision Making and Appeals (DMA) Leeds, 3E
zone E, Quarry House, Leeds. Existing arrangements for such referrals should be followed, as set out in
– Memo 7/19 Requesting case guidance from DMA Leeds for all benefits.


                                                                               DMA Leeds: March 2023
